s: SikaRoof® VersiJack® C Top Extender is an attachment used at the top of adjustable pedestals to raise the height of pedestals by 43 mm in raised flooring systems. Extenders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) and it has two clips that clip into the top of the adjustable pedestal.

SikaRoof® VersiJack® C Top Extender is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® pedestals. Extenders are typically used to correct for differences between design plans and site conditions, as opposed to going through the process of returning a particular pedestal model and reordering the correct pedestal height model.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Extenders are used with adjustable pedestals for raised flooring on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.2.
